// node shots.mjs <outDir> <base> [only-prefix]
// Bundles and Native builds at 1280 and 390, light and dark, over CDP at 2x.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const OUT = process.argv[2];
const BASE = process.argv[3] ?? "http://localhost:3000";
const ONLY = process.argv[4];
const PORT = 9372;
fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
const chrome = spawn(
  "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome",
  [
    "--headless=new",
    `--remote-debugging-port=${PORT}`,
    "--hide-scrollbars",
    `--user-data-dir=/Volumes/SSD_2TB/tmp/console-default-channel/chrome-rt-${process.pid}`,
    "about:blank",
  ],
  { stdio: "ignore" },
);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
let target;
for (let i = 0; i < 50 && !target; i += 1) {
  await sleep(200);
  try {
    target = (await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/json`)).json()).find(
      (t) => t.type === "page",
    );
  } catch {}
}
const ws = new WebSocket(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
await new Promise((r) => (ws.onopen = r));
let id = 0;
const pending = new Map();
ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
  if (msg.id && pending.has(msg.id)) {
    pending.get(msg.id)(msg);
    pending.delete(msg.id);
  }
};
const send = (method, params = {}) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => {
    id += 1;
    pending.set(id, resolve);
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
  });
const evaluate = async (expression) =>
  (await send("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true }))
    .result?.result?.value;
await send("Page.enable");


const SESSION = "evidence-session-secret-0001";
const measure = `(() => {
  const popup = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-slot=select-content]")].find((p) => p.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0);
  if (!popup) return null;
  const pr = popup.getBoundingClientRect();
  const arrows = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-slot=select-scroll-up-button], [data-slot=select-scroll-down-button]")].map((a) => { const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return { slot: a.dataset.slot.replace("select-scroll-", "").replace("-button", ""), top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), shown: r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(a).display !== "none" }; });
  const rows = [];
  for (const o of popup.querySelectorAll("[role=option]")) {
    const r = o.getBoundingClientRect();
    const top = Math.max(r.top, pr.top), bottom = Math.min(r.bottom, pr.bottom);
    if (bottom - top < 1) continue;
    const x = r.left + r.width / 2;
    let hit = 0, total = 0;
    for (let y = Math.ceil(top); y < bottom; y += 1) { total += 1; const e = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); if (e && o.contains(e)) hit += 1; }
    const cy = (top + bottom) / 2; const ce = document.elementFromPoint(x, cy);
    rows.push({ name: o.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40), visible: total, hit, centerHit: !!ce && o.contains(ce), full: Math.round(r.height) });
  }
  return { popup: { top: Math.round(pr.top), bottom: Math.round(pr.bottom), alignsWithTrigger: popup.dataset.alignTrigger, scrollTop: Math.round((popup.querySelector("[role=listbox]") ?? popup).scrollTop) }, arrows, rows };
})()`;

// Dev-only overlays (TanStack devtools, React Grab) stay out of every hit test.
const hideDev = `(() => { for (const e of document.body.children) { if (e.classList.contains("ph-no-capture") || e.textContent.startsWith("Tanstack Router")) e.style.display = "none"; } return true; })()`;
const clickAt = async (selector) => {
  await evaluate(hideDev);
  const r = await evaluate(`(() => { const el = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)}); if (!el) return null; el.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 }; })()`);
  if (!r) return false;
  for (const type of ["mouseMoved", "mousePressed", "mouseReleased"]) {
    await send("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type, x: r.x, y: r.y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
  }
  return true;
};
const waitFor = async (expr, ms = 30000) => {
  for (let t = 0; t < ms; t += 300) { if (await evaluate(expr)) return true; await sleep(300); }
  return false;
};
const go = async (url, width, height) => {
  await size(width, height);
  await send("Page.navigate", { url: `${BASE}/native-builds/devices?hot-updater-session=${SESSION}` });
  await sleep(1500);
  await evaluate(`localStorage.setItem("hot-updater-theme", "light")`);
  await send("Page.navigate", { url: `${BASE}${url}` });
  await waitFor(`document.readyState === "complete" && !document.querySelector("[data-slot=skeleton], .animate-pulse")`);
  await sleep(1200);
};

const size = async (width, height) => {
  await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width, height, deviceScaleFactor: 2, mobile: width < 768 });
  await send("Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled", { enabled: width < 768, maxTouchPoints: width < 768 ? 5 : 0 });
};
const OPEN_POPUP = `[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-slot=select-content]")].find((p) => p.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0)`;
const state = (trigger) => `(() => {
  const popup = ${OPEN_POPUP};
  const t = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(trigger)});
  const tr = t ? t.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
  if (!popup) return { open: false, value: t?.textContent.trim() };
  const pr = popup.getBoundingClientRect();
  const scroller = [popup, ...popup.querySelectorAll("*")].find((e) => e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight + 1 && getComputedStyle(e).overflowY !== "visible");
  const arrows = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-slot=select-scroll-up-button], [data-slot=select-scroll-down-button]")].filter((a) => a.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 && getComputedStyle(a).display !== "none").map((a) => a.dataset.slot.includes("up") ? "up" : "down");
  const covered = [];
  for (const o of popup.querySelectorAll("[role=option]")) {
    const r = o.getBoundingClientRect();
    const top = Math.max(r.top, pr.top), bottom = Math.min(r.bottom, pr.bottom);
    if (bottom - top < 1) continue;
    const x = r.left + r.width / 2;
    let hit = 0, total = 0;
    for (let y = Math.ceil(top); y < bottom; y += 1) { total += 1; const e = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); if (e && o.contains(e)) hit += 1; }
    const ce = document.elementFromPoint(x, (top + bottom) / 2);
    if (!(ce && o.contains(ce)) || hit < total - 1) covered.push(o.textContent.trim() + " " + hit + "/" + total);
  }
  const vw = innerWidth, vh = innerHeight;
  return {
    open: true,
    value: t?.textContent.trim(),
    side: popup.getAttribute("data-side") ?? popup.parentElement.getAttribute("data-side"),
    alignedOverTrigger: (popup.getAttribute("data-side") ?? popup.parentElement.getAttribute("data-side")) === "none",
    popup: [Math.round(pr.left), Math.round(pr.top), Math.round(pr.right), Math.round(pr.bottom)],
    trigger: tr && [Math.round(tr.left), Math.round(tr.top), Math.round(tr.right), Math.round(tr.bottom)],
    inViewport: pr.left >= -0.5 && pr.top >= -0.5 && pr.right <= vw + 0.5 && pr.bottom <= vh + 0.5,
    scroll: scroller ? { top: Math.round(scroller.scrollTop), max: scroller.scrollHeight - scroller.clientHeight } : null,
    maxHeight: getComputedStyle(popup).maxHeight,
    arrows,
    covered,
    viewport: [vw, vh],
  };
})()`;
const S = (trigger) => evaluate(state(trigger));
const optionNames = async () => evaluate(`[...${OPEN_POPUP}.querySelectorAll("[role=option]")].map((o) => o.textContent.trim())`);
const optionCenter = async (name) => evaluate(`(() => { const o = [...${OPEN_POPUP}.querySelectorAll("[role=option]")].find((e) => e.textContent.trim() === ${JSON.stringify(name)}); const r = o.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2 }; })()`);
const popupCenter = async () => evaluate(`(() => { const p = ${OPEN_POPUP}; if (!p) return null; const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2, h: r.height }; })()`);
const swipe = async (direction) => {
  // A real touch scroll gesture; "down" scrolls toward the list's end.
  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i += 1) {
    const before = (await S("body")).scroll?.top;
    const c = await popupCenter();
    if (!c) return "closed";
    await send("Input.synthesizeScrollGesture", { x: Math.round(c.x), y: Math.round(c.y), yDistance: direction === "down" ? -Math.round(c.h * 0.6) : Math.round(c.h * 0.6), gestureSourceType: "touch", speed: 1200, repeatCount: 0 });
    await sleep(400);
    const after = (await S("body")).scroll?.top;
    if (after === before) break;
  }
  return "ok";
};
const wheel = async (direction) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) {
    const before = (await S("body")).scroll?.top;
    const c = await popupCenter();
    await send("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseWheel", x: c.x, y: c.y, deltaX: 0, deltaY: direction === "down" ? 400 : -400 });
    await sleep(250);
    const after = (await S("body")).scroll?.top;
    if (after === before) break;
  }
};
const tap = async ({ x, y }) => {
  await send("Input.dispatchTouchEvent", { type: "touchStart", touchPoints: [{ x, y }] });
  await sleep(60);
  await send("Input.dispatchTouchEvent", { type: "touchEnd", touchPoints: [] });
};
const click = async ({ x, y }) => {
  for (const type of ["mouseMoved", "mousePressed", "mouseReleased"]) await send("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type, x, y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
};
const key = async (k, code, vk) => {
  await send("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "rawKeyDown", key: k, code, windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk });
  if (k === "Enter") await send("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "char", key: k, code, text: "\r", windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk });
  await send("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "keyUp", key: k, code, windowsVirtualKeyCode: vk });
};
const openBy = async (trigger, how = "mouse") => {
  await evaluate(hideDev);
  const r = await evaluate(`(() => { const b = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(trigger)}).getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 }; })()`);
  if (how === "touch") await tap(r); else await click(r);
  await waitFor(`!!(${OPEN_POPUP})?.querySelector("[role=option]")`);
  await sleep(700);
};
const log = {};
const put = (k, v) => { log[k] = v; console.log(k, JSON.stringify(v)); };
const shot = async (name) => { const { result } = await send("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png" }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.png`), Buffer.from(result.data, "base64")); };

// Each dropdown: how to reach it, and how to start it with a given option chosen.
const dropdowns = {
  "nb-channel": {
    trigger: "[aria-label=Channel]",
    async load(width, height, choose) {
      await go(choose === "first" ? "/native-builds?channels=all" : "/native-builds", width, height);
      if (choose === "last") {
        await openBy(this.trigger);
        const names = await optionNames();
        await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(500);
        await go(`/native-builds?channel=${encodeURIComponent(names.at(-1))}`, width, height);
      }
    },
  },
  "promote-target": {
    trigger: "#target-channel",
    async load(width, height, choose) {
      await go("/", width, height);
      await waitFor(`!!document.querySelector("[aria-label^='Open details for ID']")`);
      await evaluate(`document.querySelector("[aria-label^='Open details for ID']").click()`);
      await waitFor(`[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].some((b) => b.textContent.trim() === "Promote to channel")`);
      await sleep(600);
      await evaluate(`[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === "Promote to channel").click()`);
      await waitFor(`!!document.querySelector("#target-channel")`);
      await sleep(600);
      await openBy(this.trigger);
      const names = await optionNames();
      await key(choose === "first" ? "Home" : "End", choose === "first" ? "Home" : "End", choose === "first" ? 36 : 35);
      await sleep(200);
      await key("Enter", "Enter", 13);
      await sleep(700);
      void names;
    },
  },
};

const MODE = process.env.RT_CASES ?? "1,2,3,4";

// (1) Overflowing lists at 390x667: swipe and wheel to each end, tap/click the end option, End/Home + Enter.
if (MODE.includes("1")) for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(dropdowns)) {
  for (const start of ["first", "last"]) {
    const id = `1 ${name} ${start}-chosen`;
    await d.load(390, 667, start);
    await openBy(d.trigger);
    const names = await optionNames();
    const opened = await S(d.trigger);
    await shot(`case1-${name}-${start}-open`);
    // Swipe to the far end, then tap that end's option.
    const far = start === "first" ? "down" : "up";
    await swipe(far);
    const atEnd = await S(d.trigger);
    const target = far === "down" ? names.at(-1) : names[0];
    await tap(await optionCenter(target));
    await sleep(900);
    const afterTap = await S(d.trigger);
    // Wheel back to the other end, then click that end's option.
    await openBy(d.trigger);
    const back = far === "down" ? "up" : "down";
    await wheel(back);
    const atOther = await S(d.trigger);
    const target2 = back === "down" ? names.at(-1) : names[0];
    await click(await optionCenter(target2));
    await sleep(900);
    const afterClick = await S(d.trigger);
    // End + Enter, then Home + Enter.
    await openBy(d.trigger);
    await key("End", "End", 35); await sleep(250); await key("Enter", "Enter", 13); await sleep(900);
    const afterEnd = await S(d.trigger);
    await openBy(d.trigger);
    await key("Home", "Home", 36); await sleep(250); await key("Enter", "Enter", 13); await sleep(900);
    const afterHome = await S(d.trigger);
    put(id, {
      options: names.length, first: names[0], last: names.at(-1),
      opened: { inViewport: opened.inViewport, side: opened.side, arrows: opened.arrows, covered: opened.covered, scroll: opened.scroll, popup: opened.popup },
      swipe: { direction: far, scroll: atEnd.scroll, inViewport: atEnd.inViewport, arrows: atEnd.arrows, covered: atEnd.covered, tapped: target, chosen: afterTap.value, closed: !afterTap.open },
      wheel: { direction: back, scroll: atOther.scroll, inViewport: atOther.inViewport, arrows: atOther.arrows, covered: atOther.covered, clicked: target2, chosen: afterClick.value, closed: !afterClick.open },
      endEnter: { chosen: afterEnd.value, closed: !afterEnd.open },
      homeEnter: { chosen: afterHome.value, closed: !afterHome.open },
    });
  }
}

// (2) Resize an open popup across 768: 390 -> 1024 -> 390, last option chosen, list partly scrolled.
if (MODE.includes("2")) for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(dropdowns)) {
  await d.load(390, 667, "last");
  await openBy(d.trigger);
  await wheel("up"); // from the chosen last option toward the top...
  const c = await popupCenter();
  await send("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseWheel", x: c.x, y: c.y, deltaX: 0, deltaY: 300 }); // ...then partway back
  await sleep(400);
  const at390 = await S(d.trigger);
  await shot(`case2-${name}-390`);
  await size(1024, 667); await sleep(1200);
  const at1024 = await S(d.trigger);
  await shot(`case2-${name}-1024`);
  await size(390, 667); await sleep(1200);
  const back390 = await S(d.trigger);
  await shot(`case2-${name}-390-again`);
  await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(600);
  // Reopened at 390 after the round trip.
  await openBy(d.trigger);
  const reopened = await S(d.trigger);
  // And the other way: opened at 1024, resized to 390, back to 1024.
  await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(500);
  await size(1024, 667); await sleep(900);
  await openBy(d.trigger);
  const open1024 = await S(d.trigger);
  await size(390, 667); await sleep(1200);
  const to390 = await S(d.trigger);
  // Base UI closes an item-aligned popup on a resize; the next open is the phone's.
  if (!to390.open) await openBy(d.trigger);
  const reopenedAfterResize = await S(d.trigger);
  await shot(`case2-${name}-from1024-390`);
  await size(1024, 667); await sleep(1200);
  const to1024 = await S(d.trigger);
  await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(500);
  const pick = (s) => ({ open: s.open, side: s.side, popup: s.popup, trigger: s.trigger, inViewport: s.inViewport, arrows: s.arrows, covered: s.covered, scroll: s.scroll, viewport: s.viewport });
  put(`2 ${name}`, { at390: pick(at390), at1024: pick(at1024), back390: pick(back390), reopened390: pick(reopened), opened1024: pick(open1024), to390: pick(to390), reopened390AfterResize: pick(reopenedAfterResize), to1024: pick(to1024) });
}

// (3) Desktop 1280: aligned over the trigger, arrows when it scrolls, Target Channel capped at 256 px.
if (MODE.includes("3")) for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(dropdowns)) {
  await d.load(1280, 800, "last");
  await openBy(d.trigger);
  const s = await S(d.trigger);
  await shot(`case3-${name}-1280`);
  await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(500);
  put(`3 ${name}`, { side: s.side, alignedOverTrigger: s.alignedOverTrigger, arrows: s.arrows, maxHeight: s.maxHeight, popupHeight: s.popup[3] - s.popup[1], inViewport: s.inViewport });
}

// (4) First open right after hydration on a 390 load: record every side the popup ever takes.
if (MODE.includes("4")) {
  const { result: { identifier } } = await send("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", { source: `
    window.__sides = [];
    new MutationObserver((records) => {
      const note = (e) => {
        if (!(e instanceof Element)) return;
        for (const p of [e, ...e.querySelectorAll("[data-slot=select-content]")]) {
          if (!p.matches("[data-slot=select-content]") && !p.querySelector?.(":scope > [data-slot=select-content]")) continue;
          const side = p.getAttribute("data-side");
          if (side !== null) window.__sides.push(side);
        }
      };
      for (const r of records) {
        note(r.target);
        for (const n of r.addedNodes ?? []) note(n);
      }
    }).observe(document, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-side"], childList: true });
  ` });
  for (const [name, d] of Object.entries(dropdowns)) {
    if (name !== "nb-channel") continue;
    // A select enabled the moment the page hydrates: Insights' Platform. Click
    // it (mouse: the open method Base UI aligns) as soon as it exists, again
    // and again until it opens.
    await size(390, 844);
    await send("Page.navigate", { url: `${BASE}/insights` });
    const h0 = Date.now();
    let opened = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !opened; i += 1) {
      const r = await evaluate(`(() => { const t = document.querySelector("[aria-label=Platform]"); if (!t) return null; const b = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 }; })()`);
      if (r) { await click(r); await sleep(40); opened = !!(await evaluate(`!!(${OPEN_POPUP})`)); }
      else await sleep(25);
    }
    const openedMs = Date.now() - h0;
    await sleep(500);
    const insights = await S("[aria-label=Platform]");
    const insightsSides = await evaluate("window.__sides.slice()");
    put("4 insights-platform", { openedAfterMs: openedMs, side: insights.side, sidesSeen: [...new Set(insightsSides)], inViewport: insights.inViewport, arrows: insights.arrows, covered: insights.covered });
    await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(400);
    await size(390, 844);
    await send("Page.navigate", { url: `${BASE}/native-builds` });
    // Open at the first moment the trigger takes a tap.
    const t0 = Date.now();
    await waitFor(`(() => { const t = document.querySelector("[aria-label=Channel]"); return !!t && !t.disabled && !t.hasAttribute("data-disabled"); })()`, 30000);
    const ready = Date.now() - t0;
    await openBy(d.trigger, "touch");
    const touch = await S(d.trigger);
    const sidesTouch = await evaluate("window.__sides.slice()");
    await key("Escape", "Escape", 27); await sleep(400);
    await send("Page.navigate", { url: `${BASE}/native-builds` });
    await waitFor(`(() => { const t = document.querySelector("[aria-label=Channel]"); return !!t && !t.disabled && !t.hasAttribute("data-disabled"); })()`, 30000);
    await openBy(d.trigger, "mouse");
    const mouse = await S(d.trigger);
    const sidesMouse = await evaluate("window.__sides.slice()");
    put(`4 ${name}`, { triggerReadyMs: ready, touch: { side: touch.side, sidesSeen: [...new Set(sidesTouch)], arrows: touch.arrows, covered: touch.covered }, mouse: { side: mouse.side, sidesSeen: [...new Set(sidesMouse)], arrows: mouse.arrows, covered: mouse.covered } });
    await key("Escape", "Escape", 27);
  }
  await send("Page.removeScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", { identifier });
}

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, "runtime.json"), JSON.stringify(log, null, 2));
ws.close();
chrome.kill();
